title: Vicious (TV series)
lead_cast: Derek JacobiIan McKellenFrances de la TourIwan RheonMarcia WarrenPhilip Voss
premise_summary: Vicious is a British television sitcom that premiered 29 April 2013 on ITV. The series starred Ian McKellen and Derek Jacobi as Freddie and Stuart, an elderly gay couple who have been together for 50 years but endure a love–hate relationship.
